seed-drive-baseline-tree.evidence: tester-env seed empties /app/filestash-data/drive and copies seed/drive, so the local backend shows exactly five root entries (Brand/, Contracts/, Finance/, Team/, Shared-Drive-Guide.md) plus the nested dirs Contracts/archive/2025, Finance/budgets and Team/headshots. cmd_verify compares every directory's entry names against the fixture tree, so a UI-created folder or upload fails verification.

seed-stable-file-metadata.evidence: seed/mtimes.txt pins a fixed UTC mtime per seeded file and directory (2025-12-18 to 2026-10-02) and seed applies them with touch -t in the container; the 10 files also have 10 distinct sizes (134-454 bytes). cmd_verify asserts each file's size and mtime in milliseconds from /api/files/ls, so name/size/date sorts are stable across resets.

seed-mixed-file-formats.evidence: Seed provides markdown (Contracts/harbor-health-retainer.md, Contracts/kestrel-retail-loyalty-cohort-sow.md, Contracts/archive/2025/harbor-health-retainer-2025.md, Shared-Drive-Guide.md), CSV (Finance/2026-q3-invoices.csv, Finance/budgets/2026-opex-budget.csv), JSON (Brand/palette.json), plain text (Team/onboarding-notes.txt) and two 96x96 PNG images (Brand/logo-mark.png, Team/headshots/avery-chen.png) served as image/png by /api/files/cat.

seed-branded-instance-config.evidence: tester-env seed writes general.name "Meridian Analytics" (rendered as document.title) and one local connection labelled "Meridian Drive" through the same /admin/api/config round-trip the admin screens use; cmd_verify asserts both via /api/config.
